stories.name_fr: Prêt à terme conclu avec Ares
stories.explanation: Financement non dilutif sur cinq ans.
stories.story_fr: Moderna a conclu un prêt à terme de cinq ans pouvant atteindre 1,5 milliard de dollars auprès d’Ares Management Credit Funds.
stories.story_en: Moderna closed a five-year term loan facility of up to $1.5 billion from Ares Management Credit Funds.
stories.citation: Moderna announced it has closed a five-year term loan facility for up to $1.5 billion of capital from Ares Management Credit Funds

stories.explanation: Réduction par la discipline de coûts et la priorisation de la R&D.
stories.story_fr: Moderna prévoit des coûts de trésorerie d’environ 4,2 milliards de dollars en 2026.
stories.story_en: Moderna expects cash costs of approximately $4.2 billion in 2026.
stories.citation: The Company is reducing its 2026 and 2027 expected cash costs to approximately $4.2 billion and a range of $3.5 to $3.9 billion, respectively

stories.story_fr: Moderna prévoit des coûts de trésorerie de 3,5 à 3,9 milliards de dollars en 2027.
stories.story_en: Moderna expects cash costs of $3.5 to $3.9 billion in 2027.
stories.citation: The Company is reducing its 2026 and 2027 expected cash costs to approximately $4.2 billion and a range of $3.5 to $3.9 billion, respectively

stories.explanation: Efficacité industrielle du réseau de production.
stories.story_fr: Moderna prévoit d’améliorer sa marge brute de plus de 10 points de pourcentage sur les trois prochaines années.
stories.story_en: Moderna expects manufacturing improvements to lift gross margins by more than 10 percentage points over the next three years.
stories.citation: manufacturing improvements are projected to improve gross margins by more than 10 percentage points over the next three years

stories.name_fr: Produits de la franchise de vaccins saisonniers visés à 2028
stories.name_en: Seasonal vaccine franchise products targeted by 2028
stories.explanation: Passage de trois produits approuvés à six au plus.
stories.story_fr: Moderna prévoit de passer de trois à six produits approuvés au plus dans sa franchise de vaccins saisonniers d’ici 2028.
stories.story_en: Moderna expects to expand its seasonal vaccine franchise from three to up to six approved products by 2028.
stories.citation: Expects to expand seasonal vaccine franchise from three to up to six approved products by 2028

stories.story_fr: Spikevax, le vaccin de Moderna contre la COVID-19, est approuvé dans 40 pays.
stories.story_en: Spikevax, Moderna’s COVID-19 vaccine, is approved in 40 countries.
stories.citation: Spikevax (mRNA-1273, COVID-19 vaccine): Approved in 40 countries.

positionnement_ia.detail: production de bout en bout visant l’efficacité des coûts
positionnement_ia.citation: incorporating automation, robotics and AI to increase cost efficiency and reduce waste
